description: Elections Commission - Vacated Office of the member of A. G. T. Banda of the Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Hanguranketha Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local government elections, specifically addressing the status of an elected member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It fits Type 7 (Elections) as it deals with the vacancy of an elected office in a local authority.
